properties.Mechanism (MOA): Direct muscarinic agonist (M3-dominant clinically) → ↑parasympathetic effect: eye (miosis + ciliary muscle contraction) → ↑aqueous outflow → ↓IOP; glands → ↑secretions.
properties.Contraindications: Situations where increased cholinergic tone is harmful (e.g., severe asthma/COPD bronchospasm risk).
properties.Adverse effects: Sweating, salivation, GI cramping/diarrhea; bronchospasm (M3), bradycardia (M2) in susceptible patients.
